race.description: Col Wilkie Body Works Mdn Hcp
race.comment: DAIANE (4) hit the frame here when facing the starter for the first time and will have derived a stack of benefit from that race day experience. Rider Tilley sticks in the irons and can play a role with natural improvement. FOXY ARTIST (3) resumes from a spell of three-and-a-half months. Could only manage to finish eighth at the latest run over 1635m at Grafton. Good effort to launch last prep when in the money at Grafton over 1115m and looks hard to beat if back in good order. TESTY NIC (8) has been freshened up since finishing seventh over 1400m at Ballarat Synthetic. Kept up to the mark with a recent Sunshine Coast trial placing. Former Victorian who makes plenty of appeal. MISS ELLYSE (10) will strip fitter second-up from the break and may earn some minor money.
